authority: approved V3 concept PNGs compared with current real React canonical renders

layouts.approved: Deep cobalt/cyan command-center hero with a layered skyline, luminous horizon, atmospheric depth, dense KPI strip, analytical center, intelligence rail, and tightly composed task/activity surfaces.
layouts.current: The real React render has the correct shell and zones but a comparatively light hero scene, simpler KPI internals, flatter chart treatment, and lower above-the-fold information density than the approved reference.
layouts.correction: Retain all real zones and fixture/live values while adding concept-derived hero depth layers, skyline/horizon light treatment, richer KPI sparkline framing, analytical chart grid/area layering, and tighter card internals/spacing at desktop and 4K; preserve the accepted mobile text/art separation.

layouts.approved: A modular workspace canvas with a distinct hero, active quick-command surface, image-led project tiles, schedule/task columns, and layered personal workspace hierarchy.
layouts.current: The render exposes the correct workspace zones but the tiles are mostly flat white cards with limited image treatment and less contrast between active and supporting work surfaces.
layouts.correction: Use the supplied project and mountain artwork within real project/quick-action components, strengthen active-canvas surface depth, add concept-derived tile headers and visual separators, and preserve the workspace-specific grid rather than reusing Executive geometry.

layouts.approved: A control-room surface centered on a luminous operational map, route/marker texture, team/status rails, compact KPI cards, and dense operational analytics.
layouts.current: The current map is a sparse line network with a small marker set; the operational and analytics cards have less layered lighting, route texture, and information density than the approved cockpit.
layouts.correction: Keep geographic content decorative and fixture-safe while adding the supplied world/map atmosphere, layered map grid/route glow, non-data decorative marker halos, stronger cockpit panel framing, and denser real status/list/chart internals.

layouts.approved: An editorial publication layout with a large photographic-style feature story, secondary story imagery, dark/light editorial layering, and a clearly dominant publication hierarchy.
layouts.current: The corrected rectangular grid is valid, but story art is predominantly abstract geometric treatment and the feature/story hierarchy is flatter and less photographic/editorial than the approved concept.
layouts.correction: Preserve the rectangular grid and real story buttons while using all supplied editorial story assets, adding image overlays/captions, stronger feature-story scale, publication-style dividers, and concept-derived editorial contrast without using the screenshot as an image.

layouts.approved: A dense split workspace with a visibly active master list, selected record banner/detail surface, inspector-like metadata hierarchy, and rich selection affordances.
layouts.current: The list/detail zones exist and are functional, but the master rows, selected-record banner, tabs, and metadata groups are comparatively sparse and visually uniform.
layouts.correction: Increase real row metadata hierarchy, selected-state edge/glow, detail banner depth using the supplied asset, tab grouping, inspector surface framing, and chart/detail rhythm while retaining the stored/API master-detail alias contract.

layouts.approved: A panoramic wide-screen composition with a broad global visual field, map imagery, multiple analytical surfaces, and explicit use of horizontal space at 4K.
layouts.current: The render has the global panel and chart but leaves the wide composition visually lighter, with less panoramic atmosphere and supporting analytical surface depth than the reference.
layouts.correction: Use the supplied horizon/map atmosphere as a wide backdrop layer, strengthen global map and performance subpanels, increase concept-supported wide row density/minimums, and keep real metrics/data separate from decorative geography.

layouts.approved: An asymmetric bento composition with a dominant image-led tile, varied tile proportions, layered artwork, and strong visual rhythm rather than equal cards.
layouts.current: The bento structure is asymmetric but its tile art and internals remain simple gradients/patterns, reducing the image-rich hierarchy visible in the approved reference.
layouts.correction: Retain the existing bento grid while applying supplied project artwork to the correct real tiles, adding layered image masks/highlights and stronger featured-tile hierarchy without adding business values or equalizing the grid.

layouts.approved: A focused productivity surface with prominent progress visualization, task/people/project context, calm layered surfaces, and deliberate concentration hierarchy.
layouts.current: The progress ring and priority stream exist, but supporting visual context, depth, and task/project hierarchy are simpler than the approved Focus & Flow composition.
layouts.correction: Use the supplied focus atmosphere, strengthen the real progress and priority components with layered progress rings, contextual art panels, state accents, and measured spacing while keeping fixture/live task values authoritative.

layouts.approved: A creation-studio layout with a deep workflow canvas, visibly connected nodes, toolbox rail, inspector controls, and a high-detail authoring hierarchy.
layouts.current: The canvas, toolbox, and inspector are present but have flatter node treatment, lighter canvas depth, and less visual distinction between tool, canvas, and inspector surfaces.
layouts.correction: Retain real controls and node components while adding concept-derived canvas grid/depth, node headers/status treatments, connector glow layers, toolbox grouping, and inspector surface hierarchy; no fake interactions or invented data.

layouts.approved: A board-level decision surface with strong trend visualization, risk/strategy grouping, agenda/decision density, premium chart surfaces, and deliberate 4K composition.
layouts.current: The board trend and agenda zones exist but read closer to generic analytics/list cards, with less board-specific visual hierarchy, signal layering, and dense decision surface treatment.
layouts.correction: Preserve real board trend/agenda data seams while adding supplied board signal artwork, layered trend/chart framing, decision-state badges, board-specific grouping, and wider-screen composition density without inventing governance or financial facts.
